searchText: phase one — broad possibility map ux possibilities sharper rectangular glass panels with clipped or small radius corners rather than pill heavy cards. a hud like reference workspace: compact rows, status rails, and media slots instead of giant explanation cards. layered glass using one compositor friendly blur layer rather than many nested backdrop filters. subtle scan line, border trace, parallax light, and hover/focus animations with reduced motion fallbacks. stronger contrast hierarchy: black glass, graphite rails, lime data accents, violet/cyan refractions. compact restrict animated properties to transform, opacity, filter only where necessary. add contain / content visibility selectively to long off screen sections. lazy render heavy media previews and defer video metadata work. avoid whole view rerenders for prompt/reference micro updates. debounce only expensive persistence, never visible feedback. reuse object urls and revoke stale ones deterministically. avoid repeated fetches of provider status where cached state is sufficient. api verification possibilities inventory every browser awtsmoos proxy call. inventory every awtsmoos proxy minimax call. validate http methods, paths, headers, json shapes, error forwarding, timeouts, status mapping, and result extraction. validate every h3 mode against official v2 rules. validate image mime, size, dimensions, ratio, role, count, and data/public url handling. verify first/last frame roles never mix with reference roles. verify reference audio cannot be the only reference media.
